svg.title: Designed variation DU-09
svg.desc: first/second-person pronouns | Relation: five dual relations | वैदिक: The full second-person series is well represented: nominative युवम्, | accusative युवाम्, instrumental-dative -भ्याम्, ablative युवत्, and | genitive-locative -ओस्. Corresponding first-person full forms occur more narrowly, | especially in Yajus prose; the Ṛgveda more often uses enclitic नौ. | लौकिक: combines nominative and accusative as -आम्, combines | instrumental-dative-ablative as -भ्याम्, and combines genitive-locative as -अयोस् | Contribution: SEM · REL · Evidence: passage checked · function shown | Prevalence: 136 tokens · grade A | 22 tokens · grade A | 3 tokens · grade A | 31 tokens · grade A
svg.text: वैदिक: The full second-person series is well represented: nominative युवम्,
accusative युवाम्, instrumental-dative -भ्याम्, ablative युवत्, and
genitive-locative -ओस्. Corresponding first-person full forms occur more narrowly,
especially in Yajus prose; the Ṛgveda more often uses enclitic नौ.
लौकिक: combines nominative and accusative as -आम्, combines
instrumental-dative-ablative as -भ्याम्, and combines genitive-locative as -अयोस्
Contribution: SEM · REL · Evidence: passage checked · function shown
Prevalence: 136 tokens · grade A | 22 tokens · grade A | 3 tokens · grade A | 31 tokens · grade A
